title: Helicopter recovery of the 20-foot egg
summary: Jake Barber tells of Helicopter recovery of the 20-foot egg, about c. 2014 (10+ years before 2025) at off the range, California desert, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

plain: A helicopter pilot named Jake Barber says that around 2014 he flew a mission off a test range in the California desert to carry away a 20-foot object shaped like an egg, which his team simply called the egg. The podcast host Jesse Michels and a congressman, Eric Burlison, later repeat his account, and Michels presents the egg as being from another world. If true, it would mean the US quietly recovers craft that are not human-made.
